scope: Only Sankt Paulus and Heilandskirche in Moabit; Lutherkirche at Buelowstrasse is outside this task

sources.title: Dominikaner Berlin — Das Kirchengebäude
sources.use: Primary architecture account: two 45 m towers, square-to-octagonal belfries, eight-sided copper helms, orange-red brick, white joints, green glazed bands, rose and three doors. Exact small dimensions are not supplied.

sources.title: Landesdenkmalamt — Kath. St. Paulus-Kirche mit Dominikanerkloster
sources.use: Exact Moabit identity, Waldenserstrasse forecourt, twin-tower front, rose and stepped Gothic gable; attached monastery remains distinct.

sources.title: Erzbistum Berlin — St. Paulus exterior
sources.credit: Erzbistum Berlin / Dominikaner; page text credited to Sabine Steinhoff, individual photographer not identified
sources.licence: Copyright retained by source; reference only, no redistributed pixels
sources.use: Visually inspected front: central eight-petal rose, paired narrow upper belfries, dark helms, glazed brick edges, pale blind-lancet fields.

sources.title: Evangelische Kirchengemeinde Tiergarten — Heilandskirche Turmtreppe
sources.credit: Evangelische Kirchengemeinde Tiergarten; page photograph Sascha Gebauer
sources.use: Primary parish explicitly states 87 m tower height. Page photograph is not bundled.

sources.title: Turmstrasse — completed Heilandskirche refurbishment
sources.credit: Turmstrasse area management / Bezirksamt Mitte and Evangelische Kirchengemeinde Tiergarten; architects Leibenatus Stockburger Wittayer
sources.use: Completed 2016 roof/facade refurbishment, reduced corner towers and no vanished roof rider after 1956–60 reconstruction. This source says 88 m overall, conflicting with parish 87 m; model follows parish 87 m and documents the 1 m difference.

sources.title: Heilandskirche Moabit,26 March 2021
sources.use: Visually inspected present tower/clock/spire, red steep nave roof and reduced corner roofs. Reference only, no pixels bundled. Roof eave 15 m/ridge 28 m are display estimates, not survey dimensions.

sources.title: Geoportal Berlin — complete retained LoD2 archives
sources.use: Parents DEBE01YYK0002JYD and DEBE01YYK0002JYQ from archives 387_5821/387_5820; all 11 parts and 530 original wall/roof sheets retained, rigid datum shifts only.
